integrity: Complete self-contained argument and standalone exact finite-field verification are supplied. Uniform conclusions rest on the proof, not on finitely many computational examples. The same-model review is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The counts are for ordered marked Rosenhain parameters, not isomorphism classes; characteristic two, singular parameters, and the square-stratum arithmetic are not classified. The generalized restriction-of-scalars method is known and is not claimed as original; earlier equivalent specializations remain a priority risk.
title: The nonsplit Rosenhain locus: a uniform parameter count and induced genus-two zeta functions
